name: v130_annual_ebit_confidence_largecap
hypothesis: High annual EBIT estimate level with narrow dispersion and broader analyst coverage may capture operating-profit visibility away from EPSR/PTP/netprofit/detail-asset parents.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.35, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_low) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_number, 126), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

name: v130_ebit_actual_delivery_eventful
hypothesis: EBIT actual delivery above a stable analyst surface may be a different operational-delivery signal from sales surprise and PTP estimate confidence.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.50, 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
